$comment: The status checks the GitHub branch ruleset requires before a pull request can merge.
This file is the repository-side half of a contract whose other half lives in GitHub's
ruleset API, which nothing in the tree can read at build time. The two were written
independently and compared by nobody, so the ruleset came to require a check named
'source-quality-gates' while the only job that could plausibly emit it was a matrix named
'source-quality-node-${{ matrix.node }}'. With zero bypass actors configured, that made
every pull request permanently unmergeable, and no test, lint or typecheck could notice.
scripts/verify-ci-contract.mjs asserts that every name below is emitted by exactly one
workflow job whose name is a literal (a name containing a ${{ }} expression is a matrix
name and can never equal a required check), and that the emitting workflow runs on
pull_request. Adding a required check to the ruleset without adding it here does not fail
the build -- only the owner can read the ruleset -- so when the ruleset changes, this file
changes in the same pull request.
